parts.title: Snow Morning
parts.text: Noah woke up and looked out the window. It was a **chilly** morning, and a **flurry** of snow was falling. “Snow!” he shouted. Soon Yuki and Rosa came over. Yuki pulled on one red **mitten**, and then the other.

parts.title: Sled Time
parts.text: They pulled a **sled** up the hill. The snow went **crunch** under their boots. Rosa sat in front, and Noah gave a push. They began to **slide**! At the bottom, they all took a **tumble** into the soft snow.

parts.title: Warm Again
parts.text: Their noses were red, and the ground was **icy**. Yuki gave a big **huff** and white breath floated up. Back home, they made a **pile** of wet boots by the door. The kitchen was **toasty**, and the snow on their coats began to **melt**.

parts.title: A Perfect Day
parts.text: They drank hot cocoa and watched more snow fall. It was a perfect snow day. They hoped to play outside again tomorrow.
